## KeyProviderRegistry class

Registry for key provider implementations.

**Signature:**

```typescript
declare class KeyProviderRegistry 
```

## Remarks

The registry allows registration of custom key providers and provides a factory method to create provider instances from configuration.

Note: This class is used as a namespace for static methods.
